verdict.rationale: Evidence covers single-call ingestion (thread.add_messages) and data types (JSON, text, message) but nowhere describes asynchronous/batch ingestion pipelines or an API/CLI capability to check the status of background memory-processing jobs; zepctl is described only as an admin CLI for users/threads/graphs, not job-status polling. Missing for 10: batch/async ingestion endpoints, job/task status API or CLI, throughput/rate-limit guidance for large-scale ingestion.
